description: This is a Python source file implementing utility functions for FastAPI dependencies management, parameter analysis, dependency resolution, and request body handling within a FastAPI-based web application.

classes.name: ParamDetails
classes.description: A data class holding details about a function parameter, including its type annotation, dependencies, and associated ModelField.

classes.name: SolvedDependency
classes.description: A data class representing the result of dependency resolution, including resolved values, errors, and related context.

methods.name: Dependant get_dependant( *, path: str, call: Callable[..., Any], name: Optional[str] = None, own_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, parent_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, use_cache: bool = True, scope: Union[Literal["function", "request"], None] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs a Dependant object representing dependencies for a given route handler, analyzing its signature and parameters.

methods.name: Dependant get_flat_dependant( dependant: Dependant, *, skip_repeats: bool = False, visited: Optional[list[DependencyCacheKey]] = None, parent_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Flattens nested dependencies into a single level Dependant object, combining parameters and dependencies.

methods.name: inspect.Signature get_typed_signature(call: Callable[..., Any])
methods.description: Retrieves a function's signature with annotated parameter types, evaluating any string annotations.

methods.name: Any get_typed_annotation(annotation: Any, globalns: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Resolves and evaluates type annotations, including ForwardRefs, into concrete types.

methods.name: Any get_typed_return_annotation(call: Callable[..., Any])
methods.description: Retrieves and evaluates the return annotation of a function.

methods.name: ParamDetails analyze_param( *, param_name: str, annotation: Any, value: Any, is_path_param: bool, )
methods.description: Analyzes a function parameter's annotations and default values to produce a ParamDetails object, determining its dependency and ModelField info.

methods.name: None add_param_to_fields(*, field: ModelField, dependant: Dependant)
methods.description: Adds a parameter's ModelField to the appropriate list in a Dependant based on its 'in_' parameter info.

methods.name: SolvedDependency solve_dependencies( *, request: Union[Request, WebSocket], dependant: Dependant, body: Optional[Union[dict[str, Any], FormData]] = None, background_tasks: Optional[StarletteBackgroundTasks] = None, response: Optional[Response] = None, dependency_overrides_provider: Optional[Any] = None, dependency_cache: Optional[dict[DependencyCacheKey, Any]] = None, async_exit_stack: AsyncExitStack, embed_body_fields: bool, )
methods.description: Resolves all dependencies for a given endpoint, including request data, security scopes, and nested dependencies, returning a SolvedDependency.

methods.name: tuple[dict[str,Any],list[Any]] request_params_to_args( fields: Sequence[ModelField], received_params: Union[Mapping[str, Any], QueryParams, Headers], )
methods.description: Converts received request parameters (query, header, cookies) into function argument dictionaries and error lists.

methods.name: tuple[dict[str,Any],list[dict[str,Any]]] request_body_to_args( body_fields: list[ModelField], received_body: Optional[Union[dict[str, Any], FormData]], embed_body_fields: bool, )
methods.description: Processes request body data into method arguments for dependency functions, including multipart form data handling.

methods.name: Optional[ModelField] get_body_field( *, flat_dependant: Dependant, name: str, embed_body_fields: bool )
methods.description: Creates a combined ModelField representing the whole request body, optionally embedding fields.

methods.name: str get_validation_alias(field: ModelField)
methods.description: Retrieves the validation alias for a ModelField, using a custom attribute if present, otherwise defaults to the field's alias.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _extract_form_body( body_fields: list[ModelField], received_body: FormData, )
list[ModelField] _get_flat_fields_from_params(fields: list[ModelField])

inspect.Signature _get_signature(call: Callable[..., Any])
bool _should_embed_body_fields(fields: list[ModelField])
Any _solve_generator( *, dependant: Dependant, stack: AsyncExitStack, sub_values: dict[str, Any] )
tuple[Any,list[Any]] _validate_value_with_model_field( *, field: ModelField, value: Any, values: dict[str, Any], loc: tuple[str, ...] )
Optional[bool] add_non_field_param_to_dependency( *, param_name: str, type_annotation: Any, dependant: Dependant )
None ensure_multipart_is_installed()
list[ModelField] get_flat_params(dependant: Dependant)
Dependant get_parameterless_sub_dependant(*, depends: params.Depends, path: str)
bool is_union_of_base_models(field_type: Any)
